# FFS3: UNPAID WORK

**Pillar:** Financial Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** Yes  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 1, SDG 5, SDG 8, SDG 10

## Description
There was no process by the design entity or in the project where designers, including student designers, were asked to provide unpaid work, also known as free pitching or speculative work.

## Why it matters
All design work is financially compensated.
